cases.yearText: 唐建中二年（781）创建，现存大殿为唐大历年重建（782）

structureTypes.gloss: The column-and-beam frame: columns carry beams stacked in tiers, each tier smaller than the one below.
Bracket set — a stepped cluster of blocks and arms that transfers roof load outward and down into the column.

cases.principleZh: 殿堂用抬梁式木构架：柱上承大梁，梁上再抬短梁，逐层收小，把屋面荷载一层层传到柱脚；柱头铺作（斗栱）承接出挑的屋檐。这是中国现存最早的木构建筑实例。
cases.principleEn: A tailiang post-and-beam hall: large beams rest on columns, shorter beams are stacked tier on tier and each tier is smaller, so the roof load is delivered down to the column bases. Bracket sets (dougong) on the column heads carry the projecting eaves.
cases.cultureZh: 五台山南台 foothill monastery, the survival of an early-Tang timber hall that predates the Song building manual by more than two centuries.
cases.cultureEn: On the southern terrace of Mount Wutai — an early Tang timber hall that predates the Song building manual by over two centuries.

cases.yearText: 唐大中十一年（857）重建

structureTypes.gloss: The column-and-beam frame: columns carry beams stacked in tiers, each tier smaller than the one below.
Bracket set — a stepped cluster of blocks and arms that transfers roof load outward and down into the column.
Mortise and tenon — a projecting tenon fits a matching cut socket, locking two timbers without nails.
The typology of the roof — hipped, gabled, hip-and-gable, pyramidal, multi-eaved — which carries rank and climate as much as it carries load.

cases.principleZh: 大木作抬梁，七铺作双抄双下昂斗栱，梁栿用榫卯连接，柱础用覆盆式。屋内用内槽与外槽两套梁架分开承重，是「金箱斗底槽」式的空间骨架。
cases.principleEn: A tailiang frame with a seven-puzuo double-bracket set carrying beams and projecting arms; beam joints are locked by mortise and tenon. Two parallel frames — an inner and an outer row — carry the roof separately, a spatial skeleton known as the golden-coffer-and-base-trough arrangement.
cases.cultureZh: 梁思成、林徽因 1937 年实地考察认定其为唐代建筑，其「金鸡独立」的歇山屋顶与「唐代四绝」（木构、彩塑、壁画、墨书）被并称；现为国家一级博物馆与建筑史坐标原点之一。
cases.cultureEn: Identified as Tang-dynasty by Liang Sicheng and Lin Huiyin in their 1937 field survey; its single-eave hip-and-gable roof and celebrated Tang 'four treasures' — timber frame, painted sculpture, murals and ink calligraphy — anchor it as a reference point in the history of Chinese architecture.

cases.nameZh: 应县木塔（佛宫寺释迦塔）
cases.nameEn: Wooden Pagoda of Yingxian (Sakyamuni Pagoda of Fogong Temple)
cases.yearText: 辽清宁二年（1056）建成，明清多次修缮

structureTypes.gloss: Bracket set — a stepped cluster of blocks and arms that transfers roof load outward and down into the column.
The column-and-beam frame: columns carry beams stacked in tiers, each tier smaller than the one below.
Lower storeys use chuandou ties for stiffness, upper storeys use tailiang tiers to gain height.
Mortise and tenon — a projecting tenon fits a matching cut socket, locking two timbers without nails.
The typology of the roof — hipped, gabled, hip-and-gable, pyramidal, multi-eaved — which carries rank and climate as much as it carries load.

cases.principleZh: 八角五层九级、内外槽式木塔。底层用大额枋与柱网形成整体笼架；每层以平座暗层与斗栱挑出承托上层，塔身各层的斗栱做法逐层变化。全塔不用一颗铁钉，构件之间以榫卯与暗栱咬合。
cases.principleEn: An octagonal five-storey timber pagoda on a nine-stepped base, built with separate inner and outer column rings. Each level rests on a concealed dark storey and projecting bracket sets; the bracket sets change from storey to storey. No iron nails are used: the members are locked together by mortise-and-tenon joints and concealed brackets.
cases.cultureZh: 世界现存最高、最古老的木构塔式建筑，1961 年列入第一批全国重点文物保护单位。2023 年山西开展「木塔整体保护修缮」并在数字沉浸空间以裸眼 3D「逐层云登塔」。
cases.cultureEn: The tallest and oldest surviving timber pagoda in the world, inscribed on the first national list of major historical and cultural sites in 1961. A 2023 conservation campaign was paired with a naked-eye 3D walk-up experience.

cases.yearText: 北宋大中祥符六年（1013）建成，比《营造法式》成书早 90 年

structureTypes.gloss: The column-and-beam frame: columns carry beams stacked in tiers, each tier smaller than the one below.
Bracket set — a stepped cluster of blocks and arms that transfers roof load outward and down into the column.
Mortise and tenon — a projecting tenon fits a matching cut socket, locking two timbers without nails.

cases.principleZh: 抬梁式大殿，七间九架，瓜棱柱（4 根细木拼合成一根大柱）、榫卯与藻井做法被公认为目前唯一能印证《营造法式》记载的宋代实物。柱身拼合即「小材大用」：南方大料不足时，用小料拼出大柱。
cases.principleEn: A seven-bay tailiang hall of nine frames. Its melon-section columns — four slender timbers pegged together to form one column — together with its joinery and caisson ceiling are the only surviving Song-dynasty physical counterparts to what the Yingzao Fashi prescribes. Assembling a large column from small members made big timber affordable.
cases.cultureZh: 「江南第一木构」，1961 年列入第一批全国重点文物保护单位，是南宋德寿宫复原时的重要参照（两地时代相近、地域相近、用材等级同为「五等材」）。
cases.cultureEn: Called the finest Song timber building south of the Yangtze and inscribed in 1961, it served as a key reference when the Southern Song Deshou Palace was reconstructed, since the two share region, period and timber grade.

cases.nameEn: Puji Teaching Repository Hall, Huayan Temple
cases.yearText: 辽重熙七年（1038）重建（金大定十六年重修）

structureTypes.gloss: The column-and-beam frame: columns carry beams stacked in tiers, each tier smaller than the one below.
Bracket set — a stepped cluster of blocks and arms that transfers roof load outward and down into the column.

cases.principleZh: 殿身坐落在约 3 米高的台基上，抬梁与斗栱并用；殿内槽柱网与后部双槽的「金厢斗底槽」做法，是辽金木构的重要特征。
cases.principleEn: The hall stands on a raised platform of about three metres, combining tailiang framing with bracket sets. The inner column grid and the twin inner–outer rows at the rear form the golden-coffer-and-base-trough arrangement characteristic of Liao and Jin timber work.
cases.cultureZh: 下寺华严寺辽金木构的代表，薄伽教藏殿内保存辽代彩塑与明代壁画；与善化寺共同构成大同辽金木构群。
cases.cultureEn: A key Liao–Jin timber hall of the lower Huayan Temple complex, preserving Liao painted sculpture and Ming murals, together with the Shanhua Temple forming Datong's Liao–Jin timber group.

cases.yearText: 北宋皇祐四年（1052）建成

structureTypes.gloss: The column-and-beam frame: columns carry beams stacked in tiers, each tier smaller than the one below.
Bracket set — a stepped cluster of blocks and arms that transfers roof load outward and down into the column.
A hall whose frames run in two directions and meet at the centre, with porches on all four sides — the plan of the Mani Hall at Longxing Temple.
The typology of the roof — hipped, gabled, hip-and-gable, pyramidal, multi-eaved — which carries rank and climate as much as it carries load.

cases.principleZh: 单檐歇山十字形平面，四出抱厦，与一般「金厢斗底槽」矩形殿不同；抬梁式构架，纵向与横向的梁架在中心相交，屋面以多个歇山交角汇于一处，结构与造型高度统一。
cases.principleEn: A single-eave hip-and-gable hall on a cruciform plan with four projecting porches, unlike the usual rectangular golden-coffer arrangement. Tailiang frames running in both directions meet at the centre, and the roof gathers several hipped corners onto one point.
cases.cultureZh: 正定隆兴寺现存宋代建筑，1977 年修缮时于墙内发现五彩遍装绘与七彩虹泥，发现被梁思成称为「海内孤例」的宋代五彩塑。
cases.cultureEn: The surviving Song building at Longxing Temple in Zhengding, where 1977 repairs uncovered a polychrome “everywhere-decorated” scheme and the so-called “coloured sculptures of the seven colours”, a Song rarity.

cases.nameEn: Hall of the Holy Mother, Jinci
cases.yearText: 北宋天圣年间（1023–1032）重建

structureTypes.gloss: The column-and-beam frame: columns carry beams stacked in tiers, each tier smaller than the one below.
Bracket set — a stepped cluster of blocks and arms that transfers roof load outward and down into the column.

cases.principleZh: 重檐歇山顶，殿身四周一圈深远的副阶周匝，把木构与廊柱整体包住；殿内减柱法加大空间，柱网疏朗。斗栱大而疏，出跳深远。
cases.principleEn: A double-eave hip-and-gable hall wrapped on all sides by a deep surrounding verandah, enclosing the timber frame and its colonnade. Columns are omitted inside to open up the hall, and the bracket sets are large and widely spaced with long projections.
cases.cultureZh: 晋祠为晋水源头之上的祭祀建筑群，圣母殿是北宋遗构的核心，与周柏、唐槐、鱼沼飞梁并称「晋祠三绝」。
cases.cultureEn: Jinci, the ritual complex at the source of the Jin River, whose Holy Mother Hall is the Song-period core, celebrated together with the Zhou cypress, the Tang scholar tree and the Flying Bridge over the Fish Pond.

cases.yearText: 北宋大中祥符年间至绍圣年间（约 1008–1098）

structureTypes.gloss: The column-and-beam frame: columns carry beams stacked in tiers, each tier smaller than the one below.
Bracket set — a stepped cluster of blocks and arms that transfers roof load outward and down into the column.
A flat coffered ceiling or a stepped central caisson that conceals the frame, marks the rank of the space and protects it from fire and dust.

cases.cultureZh: 我国现存唯一完整保留宋代木构建筑、彩画与壁画的殿堂。2025 年「芥子须弥·开化」数字艺术展以 20 余年研究为基础，用 23 分钟 VR 漫游与复原模型把它「搬到」北京。

cases.nameZh: 福建土楼（振成楼、承启楼）
cases.locality: 龙岩市永定区 / 漳州市南靖县
cases.yearText: 明末清初形成，现存实例多建于 18—19 世纪

structureTypes.gloss: Earth is compacted in thin lifts inside formwork; lime and gravel improve strength and water resistance.
Lower storeys use chuandou ties for stiffness, upper storeys use tailiang tiers to gain height.
Mortise and tenon — a projecting tenon fits a matching cut socket, locking two timbers without nails.
The enclosed plan unit of a Chinese dwelling: ranges of rooms closed by a screen wall, which organises family structure, daylight and ventilation at once.

cases.principleZh: 外墙用夯土分层夯筑，厚可达 1.5–2 米，上窄下宽；内部以木构承重楼层，形成「外土内木」的双层体系。圆形与方形平面各有功能：方形为府第式，圆形为聚族同堂。
cases.principleEn: Outer walls are rammed earth laid in lifts, up to 1.5–2 metres thick and tapering upward; timber frames carry the internal floors, giving an earth-outside, timber-inside double system. Round plans shelter large extended families; square plans serve as formal residences.
cases.cultureZh: 闽西南客家与闽南族群的聚居形态，2008 年列入《世界遗产名录》。 UNESCO 评价其「建筑与自然环境和谐共处」，是客家「聚族而居」传统的物质证据。
cases.cultureEn: The communal dwelling of the Hakka and southern Fujian peoples, inscribed in 2008, whose UNESCO evaluation stresses the harmony of built form and natural setting and its evidence for clan-based settlement.

structureTypes.gloss: Wedge-shaped blocks (voussoirs) lean against each other; the compression line keeps the arch standing.
Chambers are excavated into living rock; the cliff mass is both the enclosure and the structure.

cases.principleZh: 在鸣沙山东麓崖壁上开凿洞窟；早期窟为覆斗顶、北魏出现中心柱与穹隆顶，隋唐转为覆斗顶或穹隆顶。崖体栈道与木构廊檐连接各窟，塑像与壁画依附于洞窟本体。
cases.principleEn: Caves hewn into the cliff face; early caves have an inverted-trough ceiling, the Northern Wei adds a central pillar and barrel vault, and Sui–Tang caves combine trough and dome ceilings. Timber galleries and walkways link the caves along the cliff.
cases.cultureZh: 1987 年首批列入《世界遗产名录》，以 492 个洞窟、约 4.5 万平方米壁画与 2,000 余身彩塑著称，是丝路艺术与多族群共生的集中体现。
cases.cultureEn: Inscribed in 1987 as part of the first group of World Heritage sites, renowned for 492 caves, some 45,000 m² of murals and over 2,000 painted sculptures — a concentrated record of Silk Road art and multi-ethnic contact.

cases.nameZh: 嵩山少林寺（常住院、塔林）
cases.yearText: 北魏太安年间（455—466）创建，现存常住院等为明清重修

structureTypes.gloss: The column-and-beam frame: columns carry beams stacked in tiers, each tier smaller than the one below.
Bracket set — a stepped cluster of blocks and arms that transfers roof load outward and down into the column.
Lower storeys use chuandou ties for stiffness, upper storeys use tailiang tiers to gain height.
The typology of the roof — hipped, gabled, hip-and-gable, pyramidal, multi-eaved — which carries rank and climate as much as it carries load.

cases.principleZh: 常住院等殿宇沿中轴排列，抬梁式构架，檐下用斗栱承托；塔林为历代祖师塔的集中区，砖塔与石塔并列，密排成林。
cases.principleEn: The halls line up on a central axis in tailiang framing with bracket sets under the eaves; the Pagoda Forest is a dense congregation of brick and stone pagodas built for successive abbots.
cases.cultureZh: 汉传佛教禅宗祖庭。少林寺建筑群以「起山门—常住院—塔林」的紧凑布局与塔林的多时代砖石塔著称，是「塔林」这一类型最集中的实例。
cases.cultureEn: The ancestral seat of Chan Buddhism, known for the compact axis of gate, abbot's hall and pagoda forest, and above all for the Pagoda Forest — the densest surviving collection of brick and stone pagodas of many periods.

cases.nameEn: Ancient Building Complex in the Wudang Mountains
cases.yearText: 明永乐十年（1412）起大规模营建，延续至清

structureTypes.gloss: The column-and-beam frame: columns carry beams stacked in tiers, each tier smaller than the one below.
Bracket set — a stepped cluster of blocks and arms that transfers roof load outward and down into the column.
Earth is compacted in thin lifts inside formwork; lime and gravel improve strength and water resistance.
The typology of the roof — hipped, gabled, hip-and-gable, pyramidal, multi-eaved — which carries rank and climate as much as it carries load.

cases.principleZh: 以宫观群沿山势铺展，木构殿宇依岩就势，铜铸殿（天一真庆宫、玄岳门等）以铸造木构替代真木；金殿为铜鎏金铸造，屋顶、转角与梁架皆为金属仿木构。
cases.principleEn: Temples spread along the mountain ridge, halls set into the rock, and some halls replace timber with bronze casting — including a gilt-bronze hall whose roof, corner brackets and frame imitate wooden construction in metal.
cases.cultureZh: 1994 年列入《世界遗产名录》，是明初「道家理想国」式宫观建设的范本，与紫禁城、泰山构成明初国家营建的整体格局。
cases.cultureEn: Inscribed in 1994, a model of early-Ming Daoist palace building and part of a coherent state programme that also produced the Forbidden City and the Mount Tai works.

cases.yearText: 距今约 7000 年（文化堆积跨度约 5000 年）

structureTypes.gloss: The floor is raised on posts above damp ground; the gap underneath is used for ventilation, animals and storage.
Mortise and tenon — a projecting tenon fits a matching cut socket, locking two timbers without nails.

cases.principleZh: 出土干栏式木构建筑构件（木桩、地板、梁枋），并发现「榫卯」技术痕迹（多榫、多孔构件），是中国已知最早的榫卯实例之一；构件用榫卯连接而非绑扎。
cases.principleEn: Excavated ganlan-type structural members — piles, floor planks, beams and purlins — together with multi-tenon and multi-socket components, among the earliest known mortise-and-tenon evidence in China; members were joined by joinery rather than lashing.
cases.cultureZh: 长江下游新石器时代晚期聚落，展示稻作、湿地适应与干栏木构的完整技术链；「干栏式建筑」与「榫卯技术」的两条线索都以此为起点。
cases.cultureEn: A late Neolithic settlement of the lower Yangtze showing the full technical chain of rice cultivation, wetland adaptation and stilted timber construction; both the stilted-building and the joinery story start here.

cases.yearText: 清道光二十一年（1841）建成，1980 年代重修抬梁

structureTypes.gloss: The floor is raised on posts above damp ground; the gap underneath is used for ventilation, animals and storage.
Bracket set — a stepped cluster of blocks and arms that transfers roof load outward and down into the column.
Mortise and tenon — a projecting tenon fits a matching cut socket, locking two timbers without nails.
The enclosed plan unit of a Chinese dwelling: ranges of rooms closed by a screen wall, which organises family structure, daylight and ventilation at once.

cases.principleZh: 底层为长方形或方形木构，四面设长廊与条凳；上部叠置多层密檐楼阁，以抬梁与穿斗混合的构架层层出挑，层层缩小形成塔形。各层不用铁钉，全靠榫卯与穿枋咬合。
cases.principleEn: A rectangular timber base with galleries and benches on all sides; above it, storeys of dense-eaved pavilions stack upward in a mixed tailiang–chuandou frame, each storey smaller than the one below, locked by joinery and through-tenons rather than nails.
cases.cultureZh: 侗族村寨的公共中心，鼓楼既是议事与集会议事之所，也是村寨的标志物；2009 年「侗族大歌」列入人类非遗，鼓楼营造技艺亦为多地非遗项目。
cases.cultureEn: The public heart of a Dong village — a place for council and assembly as much as a village emblem; the Dong Great Song was inscribed in 2009 and drum-tower construction is itself a recognised intangible heritage practice.

cases.yearText: 宋以后逐步形成，现存建筑以清末民初为主

structureTypes.gloss: The floor is raised on posts above damp ground; the gap underneath is used for ventilation, animals and storage.
Bracket set — a stepped cluster of blocks and arms that transfers roof load outward and down into the column.
Mortise and tenon — a projecting tenon fits a matching cut socket, locking two timbers without nails.
The enclosed plan unit of a Chinese dwelling: ranges of rooms closed by a screen wall, which organises family structure, daylight and ventilation at once.

cases.principleZh: 村寨依山就势，鼓楼与侗寨为公共核心；干栏式吊脚楼以木柱架高，柱脚落于石础或直接立于坡地，底层架空，可避潮湿并作畜圈仓储。屋面小青瓦，出檐深，坡度大以排洪。
cases.principleEn: The village follows the terrain, with the drum tower and assembly halls at its core. Stilted diaojiaolou houses stand on timber posts over a usable understorey, keeping the living floor clear of damp; deep eaves and steep tiled roofs shed heavy rain.
cases.cultureZh: 侗族「干栏建筑」的集中样本，2009 年侗族大歌列入人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录；鼓楼、风雨桥、萨坛构成村寨的公共建筑三件套。
cases.cultureEn: A concentrated example of Dong stilted architecture, the same cultural world in which the Dong Great Song was inscribed in 2009; the drum tower, the covered bridge and the ritual altar form the village's public trio.

cases.yearText: 始建清康熙十三年（1674），嘉庆八年（1803）重建，道光二十九年（1849）重修

structureTypes.gloss: Short logs are woven and pegged into a basket-like arch that spans far beyond the length of one beam.
Mortise and tenon — a projecting tenon fits a matching cut socket, locking two timbers without nails.
Columns are tied by penetrating tie-beams; purlins rest directly on the columns, so the frame is dense and braced.

cases.principleZh: 编梁木拱：以「三节苗五节苗」两类杆件穿、插、别、压编织成拱架，榫卯连接，不用一钉一铆。全桥以榫卯咬合与自重承压，桥面荷载由整个编织拱架承担，并把力侧向传给桥台。桥上廊屋多为四柱九檩穿斗式。
cases.principleEn: A woven timber arch: 'three-section' and 'five-section' members are threaded, interlocked and pressed together into a basket-like arch by mortise and tenon, with no nails or rivets at all. The whole woven arch carries the deck load and delivers it sideways into the abutments. The covered gallery above is typically a four-post, nine-purlin chuandou frame.
cases.cultureZh: 与溪东桥并称「泗溪姐妹桥」，为全国重点文物保护单位。2024 年 12 月，「中国木拱桥传统营造技艺」由急需保护名录转入人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录。
cases.cultureEn: Together with Xidong Bridge forms the 'Sister Bridges of Sixi'; a national major heritage site. In December 2024 the woven timber bridge craft was transferred from the Urgent Safeguarding List to the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.

cases.yearText: 明景泰四年（1453）始建，清代多次重修

structureTypes.gloss: Short logs are woven and pegged into a basket-like arch that spans far beyond the length of one beam.
Mortise and tenon — a projecting tenon fits a matching cut socket, locking two timbers without nails.

cases.principleZh: 编梁木拱廊桥，跨径为泰顺境内最大；木料以杉木、松木为主，拱架关键部位用通长、笔直、无结节的「座山老木」。桥身与桥屋受力分工：拱架承桥面，桥屋承自重与风雪。
cases.principleEn: A woven timber arch covered bridge with the longest clear span in Taishun; the arch is built mainly from Chinese fir and pine, with the key arch members chosen as long, straight, knot-free 'mountain-old' timber. The arch carries the deck; the gallery carries its own weight and the weather.
cases.cultureZh: 被收入《中国古桥技术史》；泰顺全县有 32 座古廊桥，其中国保 15 座，是「中国廊桥之乡」格局的代表。2024 年该营造技艺进入人类非遗代表作名录。

cases.principleZh: 敞肩式石拱桥：在大拱券两肩之上另开四个小拱，减小桥身自重并兼作泄洪孔；主拱为石砌拱券，拱石间以白灰与铁楔连接。桥面由石板铺砌，桥身用一端插入桥台的「敞肩」做法分散恒载。
cases.principleEn: An open-spandrel stone arch: four small relieving arches pierce the spandrels above the great arch, lightening the dead load and acting as flood outlets. The main arch is a masonry ring of voussoirs bedded in lime and secured with iron cramps; the roadway is laid in stone slabs.

cases.cultureEn: The oldest surviving open-spandrel stone arch bridge in the world, praised by Liang Sicheng as a masterwork of curve; inscribed in 1961, its design resonated across Eurasian bridge history.

cases.yearText: 清康熙四十四年至四十五年（1705—1706）建成

structureTypes.gloss: Chains or ropes carry the deck; the load pulls down and sideways, and the anchorages take the pull.

cases.principleZh: 13 条铁链（每链 124 环）并列张紧于两岸桥台铁柱与锚碇之上，铁链上铺木板成桥面。荷载使铁链同时受拉与下压，锚碇与桥台承受全部的水平拉力，因此两端桥台的锚固是成败关键。
cases.principleEn: Thirteen iron chains, each of 124 links, are tensioned in parallel between iron pillars and anchorages on the two banks, with timber planks laid across them. The load puts the chains in tension and compression; the anchorages carry the entire horizontal pull, which is why the bank structures decide whether the bridge stands.
cases.cultureZh: 藏区与内地交通的重要通道，1935 年红军飞夺泸定桥使其成为近现代史标志；现为全国重点文物保护单位。
cases.cultureEn: A vital link between Tibetan areas and the interior, and a landmark of modern Chinese history after the 1935 crossing; a nationally protected heritage site.

cases.yearText: 元代设城，明清扩建定型

structureTypes.gloss: The column-and-beam frame: columns carry beams stacked in tiers, each tier smaller than the one below.
Columns are tied by penetrating tie-beams; purlins rest directly on the columns, so the frame is dense and braced.
Wedge-shaped blocks (voussoirs) lean against each other; the compression line keeps the arch standing.
The typology of the roof — hipped, gabled, hip-and-gable, pyramidal, multi-eaved — which carries rank and climate as much as it carries load.

cases.principleZh: 城中无规矩道路网，以水系与地势自然组织；三坊一照壁的院落为纳西民居基本单元，木构用穿斗式，院墙用土石。狮子山上的万古楼为登高瞭望点，是城格局局的制高点。
cases.principleEn: The town has no formal street grid; the layout follows water and terrain. The three-sided house with a screen wall is the basic Naxi courtyard unit, framed in chuandou timber with earth and stone walls, and Lion Hill's Wangu Tower anchors the composition as its viewpoint.
cases.cultureZh: 1997 年列入《世界遗产名录》，是纳西族文化与汉地商业城市共生的样本；「三坊一照壁」是纳西民居的标志形态。
cases.cultureEn: Inscribed in 1997, a record of Naxi culture alongside a Han-style trading city; the three-sided house with a screen wall is the signature form of Naxi domestic architecture.

cases.yearText: 明清形成，近代大量改扩建

structureTypes.gloss: The column-and-beam frame: columns carry beams stacked in tiers, each tier smaller than the one below.
The floor is raised on posts above damp ground; the gap underneath is used for ventilation, animals and storage.
Lower storeys use chuandou ties for stiffness, upper storeys use tailiang tiers to gain height.
The enclosed plan unit of a Chinese dwelling: ranges of rooms closed by a screen wall, which organises family structure, daylight and ventilation at once.

cases.principleZh: 典型为「三坊一照壁」与「四合五天井」：以夯土或石砌墙围合，正房多用抬梁，两侧漏角用穿斗，照壁与厢房形成封闭院落。白族民居常用「厚墙 + 深檐 + 窄院」应对高原强日照与温差。
cases.principleEn: Typically a three-sided house with a screen wall, or a five-courtyard house: earth or stone enclosure walls, a main hall in tailiang framing, side lean-tos in chuandou, and a screen wall closing the court. Thick walls, deep eaves and a narrow courtyard buffer the plateau's strong sun and temperature swings.
cases.cultureZh: 白族民居是云南「三坊一照壁」的类型学中心，也是南方丝路建筑艺术数字博物馆的重点收录对象之一。
cases.cultureEn: The Bai dwelling is the type-centre for the three-sided-house-with-screen-wall and a focus of the Southern Silk Road architecture digital museum.

structureTypes.gloss: The floor is raised on posts above damp ground; the gap underneath is used for ventilation, animals and storage.
Wedge-shaped blocks (voussoirs) lean against each other; the compression line keeps the arch standing.
The enclosed plan unit of a Chinese dwelling: ranges of rooms closed by a screen wall, which organises family structure, daylight and ventilation at once.

cases.principleZh: 羌寨依山势建于岷江河谷，房屋以石砌为基、以木为架：片石墙与石砌底层承重，木构上层居人。寨中碉楼（羌语「碉」）为防御与瞭望，顶部四角出檐，砌石收分。
cases.principleEn: Qiang villages occupy the Min River valley, with houses built stone-below and timber-above: rubble-stone walls and stone bases carry the loads while timber occupies the upper storeys. The watchtower is the settlement's defence and lookout, corbelled inward at the top.
cases.cultureZh: 羌族村寨现存规模最大、形态最完整者之一；「羌年」于 2009 年列入急需保护的非物质文化遗产名录，2024 年 12 月转入人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录。
cases.cultureEn: One of the largest and most intact surviving Qiang settlements; the Qiang New Year festival was inscribed on the Urgent Safeguarding List in 2009 and transferred to the Representative List of Humanity in December 2024.

cases.principleZh: 井干式：原木层层横叠，转角处十字咬合形成井字壁面，故名。墙体即承重墙，围合空间不需要梁架；端部出檐、压边与地面之间留出通风缝隙以防潮。

cases.cultureZh: 与北方森林资源及狩猎生活直接相关，是「井干式」在东亚最集中的活态分布区之一；近现代亦见于俄远东与朝鲜半岛北部。
cases.cultureEn: A direct response to northern forest resources and hunting life, and one of the most continuous living distributions of log construction in East Asia, with parallels in the Russian Far East and northern Korea.

cases.yearText: 传统延续，20 世纪 50 年代以后大量改用砖木

structureTypes.gloss: Bamboo culms are lashed and tied; a light, flexible frame that is rebuilt rather than repaired.
The floor is raised on posts above damp ground; the gap underneath is used for ventilation, animals and storage.
A tall masonry or rammed platform raises the timber hall above the ground, protecting it from damp.

cases.principleZh: 竹楼以竹为柱与梁，底层架空（适应湿热与虫蚁），人住上层；屋顶陡坡小青瓦或茅草，坡面加大以适应暴雨；各户独立，多按传统「干栏式」分户布局。
cases.principleEn: Bamboo culms serve as posts and beams; the living floor is raised to cope with heat, insects and damp, and the steep roof of tile or thatch sheds heavy tropical rain. Dwellings stand separately within a stilted settlement layout.
cases.cultureZh: 热带季风环境下的适应型民居，与西双版纳的整体稻作与水系环境互为因果；竹楼在当代多被砖混结构替代。
cases.cultureEn: An adaptation to a tropical monsoon environment, inseparable from the paddy-and-water landscape of Xishuangbanna; bamboo houses have largely been replaced by brick and concrete in recent decades.

cases.yearText: 始建于 17 世纪，1693 年起陆续建成，20 世纪中叶前为历代达赖居所

structureTypes.gloss: Wedge-shaped blocks (voussoirs) lean against each other; the compression line keeps the arch standing.
Earth is compacted in thin lifts inside formwork; lime and gravel improve strength and water resistance.
The column-and-beam frame: columns carry beams stacked in tiers, each tier smaller than the one below.
Bracket set — a stepped cluster of blocks and arms that transfers roof load outward and down into the column.
The typology of the roof — hipped, gabled, hip-and-gable, pyramidal, multi-eaved — which carries rank and climate as much as it carries load.

cases.principleZh: 红宫与白宫依山垒砌，墙体用石块与夯土，厚达数米；内部木构楼阁与碉房结合，白宫有大量卵石砌筑的墙体与藏式平顶。
cases.principleEn: The Red and White Palace are piled against the rock, with walls several metres thick in stone and rammed earth; timber pavilions and blockhouses are combined inside, and the White Palace uses rounded fieldstone walls with flat Tibetan roofs.
cases.cultureZh: 世界屋脊的宫殿建筑群，1994 年列入《世界遗产名录》；其「红白」体量并置与山体关系，是藏式建筑与高山水碉体系的代表。
cases.cultureEn: A palace complex on the roof of the world, inscribed in 1994; the paired red and white masses against the mountain embody the Tibetan blockhouse and fortress system at high altitude.

cases.yearText: 唐景龙元年（707）建成，明清多次修缮

structureTypes.gloss: A tapering stack of storeys built of brick or stone; each storey repeats a simple structural bay.
The typology of the roof — hipped, gabled, hip-and-gable, pyramidal, multi-eaved — which carries rank and climate as much as it carries load.

cases.principleZh: 密檐式砖塔：塔身由砖砌筒状塔壁围合，每层以叠涩砖檐出挑，壁内设券门与楼梯。塔壁与楼层是同一结构，不设木构楼层。
cases.principleEn: A dense-eaved brick pagoda: a cylindrical brick shell encloses the body, each storey corbelled out with stepped brick eaves, with vaulted entrances and a stair inside. Wall and storey are one structure; there are no timber floors.
cases.cultureZh: 唐代长安城内保存至今的少数砖塔之一，与大雁塔同为唐代佛塔制度的重要遗存；20 世纪因地基不均匀沉降已明显倾斜。
cases.cultureEn: One of the few Tang brick pagodas surviving in Chang'an, a key remnant of the Tang pagoda system alongside the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda; it leans noticeably from uneven settlement.

cases.yearText: 清道光二十九年（1849）重建

structureTypes.gloss: Bracket set — a stepped cluster of blocks and arms that transfers roof load outward and down into the column.
The column-and-beam frame: columns carry beams stacked in tiers, each tier smaller than the one below.
Mortise and tenon — a projecting tenon fits a matching cut socket, locking two timbers without nails.
The typology of the roof — hipped, gabled, hip-and-gable, pyramidal, multi-eaved — which carries rank and climate as much as it carries load.

cases.principleZh: 纯木构高楼，三层四檐、逐层出挑；不用一钉，全以榫卯与斗栱咬合，悬柱与雀替层层外伸，梁架整体性强。因无柱网，竖向受力靠柱与枋的咬合与楼层的水平联系。
cases.principleEn: A pure timber tower of three storeys and four eaves, each projecting further out; it uses no nails, only mortise-and-tenon joints and bracket sets, with suspended columns and sparrow braces extending outward and a strongly unified frame.
cases.cultureZh: 被称为「中华第一木楼」，与应县木塔、飞云楼并称山西三大木构名楼；其「无钉无铁」的纯木高层技术在中国现存木构中极为罕见。
cases.cultureEn: Called China's foremost timber tower and grouped with the Yingxian Pagoda as one of Shanxi's three great timber landmarks; a nail-free multi-storey timber frame of rare survival in China.

cases.yearText: 北宋皇祐五年至嘉祐四年（1053—1059）建，现存桥体 1950 年代原址重建
cases.yearUncertainty: 确切（始建）；现存形制为 20 世纪重建

structureTypes.gloss: Wedge-shaped blocks (voussoirs) lean against each other; the compression line keeps the arch standing.
Earth is compacted in thin lifts inside formwork; lime and gravel improve strength and water resistance.

cases.principleZh: 梁式石桥：桥面由长条石梁平铺搭接，两端搁在石砌桥墩上，靠墩顶转角与石梁自重受力，不用拱券。桥墩以条石叠砌，形状为船形，减小水流冲击；两端桥台做分水尖与筏形基础，并以种植牡蛎固结基脚。
cases.principleEn: A beam bridge of long stone slabs laid side by side, each end resting on a masonry pier; the slabs work by self-weight and bearing on the pier tops rather than by arch action. The boat-shaped piers, built of coursed ashlar, reduce the force of the current, and the abutments are founded on a raft base consolidated with cultured oysters.
cases.cultureZh: 北宋建成的跨海梁式石桥，「万安桥」旧名，桥身与桥墩石构、桥面石梁；其「种蛎固基」以牡蛎附着胶结基脚，是中国桥梁史上少见的生物材料加固做法。作为组成部分列入「泉州：宋元中国的世界海洋商贸中心」（UNESCO 编号 1561）。
cases.cultureEn: A sea-crossing stone beam bridge built in the Northern Song, historically called Wan'an Bridge, with masonry piers carrying stone slabs; its practice of founding the piers on beds of cultivated oysters is an unusual biological consolidation technique in Chinese bridge history. It forms part of the UNESCO-listed serial property Quanzhou: Emporium of the World in Song-Yuan China (ref. 1561).

cases.nameZh: 陕西三原柏社村地坑窑院
cases.nameEn: Baise Village Sunken-Pit Courtyards, Sanyuan, Shaanxi
cases.eraEn: Continuing tradition — no single founding date
cases.yearText: 持续性传统，无单一始建年；村寨相传始建于晋代

structureTypes.gloss: Rooms are hollowed out of a loess cliff or dug below ground; the soil itself is the structure.
Earth is compacted in thin lifts inside formwork; lime and gravel improve strength and water resistance.
The enclosed plan unit of a Chinese dwelling: ranges of rooms closed by a screen wall, which organises family structure, daylight and ventilation at once.

cases.principleZh: 在黄土台塬上向下挖出方形或长方形地坑，坑壁即屋壁，再在壁内掏挖券洞居室，坑口四周砌筑矮墙形成院落。洞顶用土坯或砖券起券，地面做排水明沟。数字博物馆记录的历史环境要素包括「下沉式地窑」「崖窑」「关中民居」三类。
cases.principleEn: Square or rectangular pits are dug down into the loess plateau, their walls forming the house walls; vaulted cave rooms are then hollowed out of those walls and the pit edge is enclosed by a low parapet to make a courtyard. The vaults are corbelled or brick-jacketed above and the surface is drained by open ditches. The digital museum records three building heritage elements: the sunken pit cave, the cliff cave, and the Guanzhong dwelling.
cases.cultureZh: 关中塬区「见树不见村、见村不见房、闻声不见人」民居形态的代表：柏社村位于三原县城西北 25 公里，下辖 15 个村民小组、780 户、3756 人，村史相传逾一千六百年。窑洞营造技艺已列入国家级非物质文化遗产名录，陕北与甘肃庆阳做法各有侧重。
cases.cultureEn: Baise is the clearest expression of the Guanzhong plateau pattern of 'trees without a village, a village without visible houses, voices without visible people': it lies 25 km north-west of Sanyuan county seat, with 15 natural groups, 780 households and 3,756 residents, and a tradition traced back more than sixteen centuries. Yaodong construction technique is listed among China's national intangible cultural heritage, with the northern Shaanxi and Gansu Qingyang variants each having their own emphasis.
